decision_rule: Lead with systems leadership; add scale only when seniority or mandate size is tested.
Use Pansophic for the most recent enterprise scope; Essence or Starcom for historical scale.
Prefer Pansophic for the most recent enterprise transformation; use NP Digital for agency-side transformation.
Use the $500K reallocation for a direct capital-movement decision; use the nine-school test when the question is about allocation logic or experimentation.
Use the nine-school test for questions about channel mix, experimentation, or school-level allocation. Do not attach the 17% to 28% outcome or the $500K reallocation to this test.
Frame the 17% to 28% movement as an observed portfolio outcome following YouTube reintroduction within the broader mix; do not claim YouTube-only causality.
WEX is the default acquisition-rebuild evidence; keep the metric at approved applications.
Use Stand Together for operating leadership plus quantified performance.
Use Essence for large-team scale; if direct-report count is required, use the exact Stand Together claim.
Essence is the default global-scale evidence.
Frame as operating-model and accountability work, not generic vendor management.
Use NP Digital for agency-side operating leadership; add WEX only if client performance is also requested.
Use the 60+ campaign restructure; do not attach unrelated downstream outcomes.
Lead with the five-workstream system; 150+ pages are infrastructure scale, not experiment count.

Use Pansophic for platform-to-Salesforce, attribution, dashboard and deeper-funnel signal architecture; MarTech/MMM/incrementality evidence is valid at the evaluation, interpretation, and roadmap-design level unless separately evidenced as completed.
Use Myron when a true revenue-linked outcome is required; do not substitute upper-funnel metrics.
Use the online-pharmacy example and keep it scoped to that engagement.
Use Butler/Till for quantified adoption; do not translate adoption into revenue.
Use Starcom for managed-investment growth and Essence for global scale.
Show practical governed use; never imply autonomous decisions or maturity beyond inspectable evidence.
